title: Repair the coat check
starter:
let coat_check (slips : (string * string) list) : int list =
  let notebook = Hashtbl.create 16 in
  List.map
    (fun (color, size) ->
      let slip = (color, "") in
      match Hashtbl.find_opt notebook slip with
      | Some _ -> Hashtbl.length notebook
      | None ->
        let ticket = Hashtbl.length notebook in
        Hashtbl.add notebook slip ticket;
        ignore size;
        ticket)
    slips
hints: Try the two samples by hand. In the first, what should the second `red M` slip get? In the second, are `red M` and `red L` the same coat?
The slip has to say everything that makes one coat different from another: the color and the size. Right now the size part is always `""`.
Make the slip `(color, size)`. On a hit, name the stored ticket with `Some ticket` and return `ticket`. You can then delete the `ignore size;` line.
explain: The slip `(color, size)` describes exactly one coat, so a red M and a red L get different hooks. When the slip is already in the notebook, returning the stored ticket hands back the hook that coat already hangs on, and no new hook is used. Swap coats for nodes and this is the table lesson 1.1 asks you to repair.
